claim: Regular divisibility of coefficients yields a regular multiple in an actual framed module

obligations.constructed_input: An actual linear equivalence e:V≃K, not a selected curve field
obligations.justification: No domain, field, characteristic or geometry assumption

obligations.name: Regular data
obligations.required_input: t,k in K and vectors in V
obligations.constructed_input: Only k is a unit; t may vanish or be a zero divisor

obligations.name: Coefficient hypothesis

obligations.name: Known vector

obligations.name: Multiplication

obligations.name: Alternative input

obligations.name: Validation
